items.title: Why a drawer catches halfway closed
items.content:
Message 1 — Repair Notes
A drawer that catches halfway closed may have a runner that is slightly out of parallel. Empty the drawer before inspecting it. Compare the gaps at the front and rear; a narrowing gap can reveal the alignment problem. A rubbing mark may show where movement stops. This issue also explains why forcing the drawer can damage an otherwise repairable runner. This is optional reading, with no reply requested.
